item.title: Borrowed Identity & Mechanical Soul Brother - Return To Yourself EP
item.description: Label: Quintessentials | Prix: 20,00 € | Style: House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Quintessentials

Prix: 20,00 €

Style: House

While Christian Soukup AKA Borrowed Identity has released plenty of fine solo music over the years, some of his most ear-catching and potent numbers have come alongside friend and regular studio buddy Mechanical Soul Brother. The pair's latest missive for Quintessentials is undeniably excellent, with lead cut 'Just Be Yourself' offering an enticing mix of soulful, Leroy Burgess style vocals, acid tweaks and jackin', Chicago style machine drums. The influence of Chicago, and Larry Heard's Mr Fingers project in particular, can also be heard on the wonderfully deep, dreamy, nostalgic and soulful 'Since That Day'. Over on side B, we get two takes on 'Point of No Return': the '2am' take, a melodious, shuffling and deliciously dreamy deep house workout underpinned by loose-limbed house breaks, and the smoother, chunkier and even more loved-up '6am' pass.

Tracklist:

  • A1. Just Be Yourself
  • A2. Since That Day
  • B1. Point Of No Return (2 Am)
  • B2. Point Of No Return (6 Am)

item.title: Aubrey vs Georgios DSR - Shifting Phase
item.description: Label: Deep Series | Prix: 20,00 € | Style: Deep House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Deep Series

Prix: 20,00 €

Style: Deep House

This split pairs a couple of serious techno heads and is deep, patient, and unbothered by current trend cycles. Aubrey opens with real character on 'Insectos de la Luna,' which shimmers and evolves organically, while 'Flying Low' leans into a weightless, jazz-inflected groove that never rushes. Georgios DSR takes the flip into more functional terrain, firstly with 'Analog Ground' locking into a solid groove before 'Signal Drift' settles into something nice and hypnotic. Nothing here chases a formula but is rooted in classic house and techno instincts while staying open to psychedelic detours. The Deep Series continues to excel with this one.

Tracklist:

  • A1.Aubrey - Insectos De La Luna
  • A2. Aubrey - Flying Low
  • B1. Georgios DSR - Analog Ground (LiVRO Groove Shape)
  • B2. Georgios DSR - Signal Drift

item.title: DJ Sneak - Chicago House
item.description: Label: Frappé | Prix: 14,00 € | Style: House, Chicago House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Frappé

Prix: 14,00 €

Style: House, Chicago House

DJ Sneak returns from Dance Music sabbatical with massive new Chicago House EP on Parisian imprint Frappé. The 4 tracks on the Frappé EP are crafted in Sneak's signature uncompromising and gritty style. The title track "Chicago House" brings the purest of filtered sampling, a Sneak tradition and a firm blast from the past packaged up neatly for both the veteran and new clubbers alike. "I need you" is all about that house groove. Layered chunky drums, smooth vocals and sweet synth pads lay the foundations to another classic cut. "When you dance" has a bouncy, looping melody that utilises driving drum loops and mesmeric vocals to deliver an instant hook. This is a pure cut, engineered for dancefloors. "A little Acid" completes the collection on a more electronic tip, with Sneak tweaking the 303 in his ever so distinctively funky way. The record will be out exclusively on vinyl for the first 6 month complete with a special colour cover of different Sneak visuals on the back and front, it's likely to be flying off the shelves quickly!

Tracklist:

  • A1.Chicago House Music
  • A2.I Need You
  • B1.When You Dance
  • B2.A Little Acid

item.title: Dj Sneak - Disko Dialogue
item.description: Label: Frappé | Prix: 14,00 € | Style: House , Chicago House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Frappé

Prix: 14,00 €

Style: House , Chicago House

Original Chi-Town bad man DJ Sneak shows up with his latest selection of loop-driven house jams, serving up five floor-focused cuts on the 'Disko Dialogue' EP. A key figure in the second wave of Chicago house, his prolific career has seen him explore acid house, disco cut-ups, and hypnotic, tracky realms. Much, if not all, of that is on display here. The title track features looped strings and echoing vocals over a pounding kick and skippy snares, while 'Kick Da Flow' follows a similar trajectory, albeit with a slightly more restrained mood. 'Bottom Acid' ups the energy with pulsing 303 gliding over piercing drums, while 'Acid Wunders' dives into trippier territory, with its nocturnal groove endlessly undulating. The rolling rhythms of 'Elements' cap a fine EP, with DJ Sneak proving he's lost none of his big-room bravado or production swagger.

Tracklist:

  • A1. Disko Diaogue
  • A2. Kick Da Flow
  • B1. Bottom Acid
  • B2. Acid Wunders
  • B3. Elements

item.title: Various Artists - French Kiff
item.description: Label: Frappé | Prix: 14,00 € | Style: House , Deep House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Frappé

Prix: 14,00 €

Style: House , Deep House

Frappé, the label to follow in 2021, supported by Laurent GARNIER who has recently said about them: "This label is on fire .... Looove the hard party vibe from the whole thing, and also love the cheekiness of some tracks. With tracks with huge samples from CHANGE, to tracks with obvious influence from "St Germain" ...These guys know the score..." The French label is already making a strong comeback with a fourth release: a pure House Music-infused Various Artists EP. Each of the 5 tracks explores a different aspect of what makes the House music sound of today, and yesterday, keeping intact the very Frenchy and dancefloor DNA of the label. Once more, Frappé is bringing together artists coming from different backgrounds, putting on a same record Lo-fi, Jazzy, Garage and French Touch influences. Frappé is collaborating for the first time with a non-French artist and has picked a rising star of the electronic music scene in the person of northern-Irish producer Mark Blair. For the young prodigy, this is also his first release on vinyl, likely to make "French Kiff" a collectable item on Discogs soon! He is making his mark on this wax with "Tropicana", a track as simple as it is efficient on which house chords are supporting a warm and sensual trumpet riff. All this is made in the lo-fi fashion which is his signature sound. The release features also great tracks from Naux, Groove Boys Project, and the label owners : Basile de Suresnes and Ten Fingerz

Tracklist:

  • A1. Mark Blair - Tropicana
  • A2. Naux - Kristofer
  • B1. Groove Boys Project - Groove Box (Paname club mix)
  • B2. Basile De Suresnes - French Toast
  • B3. Ten Fingerz - Ze Party

Paris groove mechanic Vaudafunk lines up 'The Vaudafunkiest' EP for the cream-toppers at Frappe Records, gathering four of his sharpest, most floor-ready cuts for the label, plus two fresh remixes from core members of the Frappe crew. The French producer refines his funk-driven house blueprint, that is crisp percussion, elastic basslines and chopped-up vocal stabs, where 'Plage Privee', 'Amour Fatal' and more realise the seduction factor of heady, croaky female French-language spoken word recordings layered on top. A pink nocturne of an EP, like a sonic fairy tale played out against a black backdrop.

item.title: Satoshi Tomiie / Ron Trent - Thursday 2am (Ron Trent remixes)
item.description: Label: Abstract Architecture | Prix: 20,00 € | Style: House , Deep House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Abstract Architecture

Prix: 20,00 €

Style: House , Deep House

A decade ago, following the release of Satoshi Tomiie's fantastic New Day album, the New York-based Japanese artist delivered an EP featuring Ron Trent interpretations of LP highlight 'Thursday, 2am'. Now he's decided to reissue them, removing his 'tool dub edit' and adding what appears to be a previously unreleased '7am Dub', an ultra-deep, fluid, electronic and astonishingly immersive chunk of early morning dancefloor hypnotism. Like the other two mixes (the EP-opening main remix, with its starry keys, undulating bass, bonus hand percussion and jazzy synth stabs, and the more stripped-back and groove-based 'remix dub'), the '7am Dub' recalls the warm, ultra-dreamy and intoxicating sound with which Trent made his name on Prescription Records way back in the late 1990s.

Tracklist:

  • B1. Thursday, 2am (Ron Trent 7am dub)

item.content:encoded:

'Higher Me' is a storming, tech-tinged slice of brilliantly crispy dub house, driven by the soulful vocals of Prince Morella and rooted somewhere between Chicago swing, Berlin precision and Kingston depth. The original comes as both a full vocal cut and a cavernous dub, each balancing razor sharp percussion with rolling low-end pressure and fuzzy textures. On the flip, Mob's rework pushes further into dub techno territory by tightening the groove and amplifying the throbbing low end with spacious chords and submerged textures. A heavyweight package for serious systems.

item.title: Mood II Swing Presents Wall of Sound - Penetration (Reissue)
item.description: Label: Groovin Records | Prix: 20,00 € | Style: House , Classic House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Groovin Records

Prix: 20,00 €

Style: House , Classic House

On their latest must-grab reissue, Italian outlet Groovin' Records takes us back to 1992 and the sole release from Mood II Swing side project Wall of Sound. Those familiar with John Ciafone and Lem Springsteen's collaborative work will know exactly what to expect. Opener 'Perception', for example, sees them pepper a typically swinging and bumping garage-house groove with cut-up sax and vocal snippets, as well as some choice organ stabs, while '8 Ways To Knock Down a Wall' is a groove-based celebration of the pair's infamous drum programming with added TB-303 bass. Over on side B, we get two takes on 'I Need Your Love Right Now': the righteous, lightly gospel-tinged garage-house bump-and-grind of the 'Lem's Church Mix' and the deeper, hazier and more hypnotic Balo revision.

Tracklist:

  • A1. Penetration
  • A2. 8 Ways To Knock Down A Wall
  • B1. I Need Your Luv (Right Now) (Lem's Church mix)
  • B2. I Need Your Luv (Right Now) (Balo's Banji mix)

item.title: Lego - El Ritmo De Verdad (Reissue)
item.description: Label: Groovin Records | Prix: 20,00 € | Style: Latin House , Classic House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Groovin Records

Prix: 20,00 €

Style: Latin House , Classic House

Groovin' Records latest must-check reissue takes us back to the turn of the millennium and the most successful single from Chicagoan deep house/Latin house fusionist Rafeal Rodriguez aka Lego. First released in 1999 and reissued a year later with fresh rubs, 'El Ritmo De Verdad' is a prime slice of Latin disco/chunky deep house fusion rich in heady hand percussion, snaking saxophone motifs, taut female vocals and relentless bass guitar. The producer's own peerless extended mix comes backed by its most celebrated rework, a killer revision from Sheffield two-some Swag. Their take is deeper, warmer and much more loose-limbed rhythmically, sitting somewhere between Jazzanova productions of the period and their similarly inspired remix of Metro Area classic 'Pina'. 26 years on, the remix has lost none of its shine; it still sounds as infectious and floor-friendly now as it day back in 2000.

Tracklist:

  • A1. El Ritmo De Verdad (extended mix)
  • B1. El Ritmo De Verdad (Swag's Machacado dub)

item.title: Frank O' Moiraghi Feat Amnesia - Feel My Body (Reissue)
item.description: Label: Groovin Records | Prix: 20,00 € | Style: Italian Classic , Funky House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Groovin Records

Prix: 20,00 €

Style: Italian Classic , Funky House

Way back in 1995, Italian producer Franco 'Frank O' Moiraghi scored a sizable crossover club hit with 'Feel My Body, a house-tempo throb-job rich in druggy, arpeggio-style bass (borrowed from an old Giorgio Moroder jam), spacey chords and wide-eyed female vocal snippets (the sung samples that inspired the track's title, fact fans). This Groovin' Records reissue boasts all three mixes from the original UMM release. Moiraghi's A-side extended mix is the most atmospheric and clandestine of the lot - a proper late-night delight in which organ loops ride the throbbing, muscular groove. It comes backed with the Tenaglia and Junior Vasquez-inspired 'Frank O mix' and the more trippy, hypnotic and trance-inducing 'FM mix'.

Tracklist:

  • A1. Feel My Body (Frank 'O' Moiraghi mix)
  • B1. Feel My Body (Frank'O mix)
  • B2. Feel My Body (FM mix)

item.title: DFRA - All About You EP
item.description: Label: Groovin Records | Prix: 20,00 € | Style: House , Jazz House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Groovin Records

Prix: 20,00 €

Style: House , Jazz House

Argentinian deep house maestro DFRA returns to Groovin Recordings while still riding high off the success of his other project, the DFRA Experience Jazz Band, for a second 12". Where his debut leaned heavily into live modal jazz and bebop structures woven through electronic production, this follow-up finds him pivot back toward the late-night dancefloor and just in time for some mid-summer heat. A masterclass in clean, sophisticated deep house, the Buenos Aires producer pairs crisp percussion with warm, hypnotic basslines and soulful chord work throughout. From the vocal-tinged groove of the title track to the moodier late-night cuts on the flip, this one strikes a rare balance between classic and modern.

Tracklist:

  • A1. All About You
  • A2. Late Night Coffee
  • B1. Subterfuge
  • B2. GUS
